name: PDMS OPLS-AA with Qeq charges (Xiang et al., J. Phys. Chem. B 129 (2025), doi:10.1021/acs.jpcb.4c08471)
source: https://github.com/COMO-lab/PDMS_benchmark param/OPLS/opls_system.in.settings and opls_system.data: the parameters the benchmark's 64 x 50-mer MDnM melt actually uses, per atom environment
reason: OPLS-AA 2024 has no Si type for a siloxane D unit and no Si-O-Si torsions, so PDMS uses a dedicated force field.
units: LAMMPS real: kcal/mol, Angstrom, degrees; E_bond = K (r - r0)^2, E_angle = K (theta - theta0)^2, OPLS dihedral K1..K4; geometric mixing; 1-4 LJ and Coulomb x 0.5

O_end.note: O bonded to a trimethylsilyl Si. The benchmark gives -1.255 to one and -1.261 to the other end O of each chain; their mean keeps every chain exactly neutral and both ends equal.
